title: phi-FD, a second order finite difference scheme for geometries defined by a level-set function: the Neumann case
summary: We extend the phi-FD finite-difference scheme, which handles domains described by a level-set function on a Cartesian grid, to Neumann boundary conditions. The condition is relaxed near the boundary through the level-set and an auxiliary field, which is eliminated by writing the relaxed condition at a boundary node and at its nearest interior node. The scheme uses only interior nodes and the level-set: no ghost values, flux reconstruction or cut-cell volumes.
